purpose: DL-055 evidence: confirms every alias authored in ch05-interconnection.json and ch07-state.json is the factually correct fully-qualified name in the real fixture source, and that sysml2d model_index.py (pinned commit 1af88250d355f4e218f6653ef934e93ac8319cd6) cannot resolve the correctly-qualified form -- only a truncated, package-prefix-dropped form that would be a wrong qualified name if used as an alias target.
root_cause: build_model_index pops package_stack/def_stack on every line starting with "}", regardless of whether a tracked keyword (package/part def/state def/action/state/interaction/use case) opened it. Both ch05.sysml and ch07.sysml contain an untracked brace pair inside action def ApplyHeat ("in duration : ISQ::DurationValue[0..*] { doc /* ... */ }", lines 16-20), whose closing "}" pops the real ApplyHeat action frame one line early; a later "assert constraint balance { ... }" (kind matched by the regex but not in the push-eligible set) then pops package_stack itself on its own closing "}", erasing the ToasterDemo package prefix before any part def / state def is reached.

interpretation.ch05.sysml: ToasterDemo::Toaster and ToasterDemo::Toaster::heating (the real, correct qualified names) are NOT resolved; the indexer only resolves the truncated, incorrectly-qualified Toaster / Toaster::heating forms.
interpretation.ch07.sysml: ToasterDemo::Cycle and ToasterDemo::Cycle::idle (the real, correct qualified names) are NOT resolved; the indexer only resolves the truncated, incorrectly-qualified Cycle / Cycle::idle forms.
interpretation.ch05_two_cause_note: Reviewer correction (round 3 push-back): of ch05-interconnection.sysmld's 6 SYSMLD-REF-002 errors, only 4 (toaster, heating, control, conn-control-heating) are this indexer bug. The other 2 (control--heating--src, control--heating--tgt) are compose-auto-generated connector-endpoint element ids that ch05-interconnection.json never aliases -- a gap inherited verbatim from the plan's own Task 6 JSON text (the original toy-fixture study's analogous toaster-mech-composed.json did alias its equivalent endpoint ids, e.g. lever--carriage--src/-tgt; this plan's ch05 JSON omitted the equivalent for ch05). That gap is independent of the indexer bug and is not something introduced during authoring here. The reviewer confirmed in a scratch (uncommitted) copy that adding those two aliases still leaves ch05 failing 6/6 against the unpatched indexer, so the bottom-line finding (SysMLD fails on real content, tool not patched, no SVG, per DL-055) is unaffected either way. Per the orchestrator's ruling, adding the missing endpoint aliases to chase a clean ch05 render is out of scope (would be completing/fixing a candidate that is explicitly not adopted).

conclusion: The 12 aliases authored across ch05-interconnection.json and ch07-state.json are all correct. ch07-state.sysmld's render/validate failure (8/8 errors, all real aliases) is a clean, single-cause confirmation of the indexer bug alone -- ch07-state-sysmld-render.log and ch07-state-sysmld-validate.log fail entirely because of it. ch05-interconnection.sysmld's failure (6/6 errors) has TWO independent causes: the indexer bug (4 of the 6 errors: toaster, heating, control, conn-control-heating -- confirmed sufficient on its own to block ch05, the same way it blocks ch07) AND a separate, pre-existing gap in this task's own intent file, which never aliased the two auto-generated connector-endpoint ids the composed .sysmld references (2 of the 6 errors: control--heating--src, control--heating--tgt; see ch05_two_cause_note above). Because of that second, independent cause, whether ch05 would render cleanly if the indexer bug alone were fixed is NOT verified either way -- unlike ch07, which is a clean, single-cause confirmation that the indexer bug alone is sufficient to block it. Per ACE ruling DL-055 (and its round-3 addendum), this is still the Phase 0 finding for SysMLD on real fixture content, not a blocker to fix by mangling alias values to a technically-incorrect but indexer-friendly form, and not a reason to add the missing ch05 endpoint aliases (out of scope).
